description: Full-stack geo tools for AI agents via MCP — one server covering geocoding, multi-profile routing (auto, truck, bicycle, pedestrian), isochrones, live traffic, weather, and place search. Coordinates you can actually route from: intersection-level precision with confidence scores, no silent fallbacks. Trucking constraints (hazmat, dimensions, weight, time/distance) native. 19 tools (geocode, geocode_structured, reverse_geocode, batch_geocode, resolve_intersection, directions, distance_matrix, isochrone, locate, map_match, trace_attributes, geofence_contains, traffic, weather, search_places, explore, place_get, quota, issue_api_key). OAuth 2.1 (keyless) or API key auth. Globally edge-deployed, flat pricing at scale.
